analysis_policy.functions: 36 fixed original-output functions and fixed scales from development reference contract
analysis_policy.reference_shift: shared +/-2 MCSE sensitivity, not a confidence interval
analysis_policy.reference_uncertainty: Keep finite MCSE and uncertified quadrature limits; no invented true MSE
analysis_policy.resampling_unit: whole original four-chain repetitions, shared within each model

cost_policy.batch_overhead: preparation, archive, transfer and verification ledger; no arbitrary per-fit allocation
cost_policy.cached: separate prepared-execution measurement using selected original repetitions
cost_policy.research: independent audit plus external invocation history

execution_policy.cache_after: Primary batch terminated or explicitly retained interrupted, with native Job end proof
execution_policy.host_lock: one shared absolute native Windows lease, with active legacy/new cohorts reconciled
execution_policy.infrastructure_retry: at most one explicit same-identity posterior retry; none for cache
execution_policy.later_batches: Only after the preceding main/cache phases have no unvisited or active tasks
execution_policy.primary_order: frozen independent schedule stream within repetition blocks
execution_policy.resource_wait: stop at task boundary without relabeling not-run tasks as numerical failures

storage_policy.scope: Per-volume conditional capacity; receiver capacity is not Windows capacity
